content: The objective ( EQREF6 ) is minimized using stochastic gradient descent by iterating over the matrix of cooccurrence records INLINEFORM0 . In the GloVe algorithm, for a given word INLINEFORM1 , the final word representation is taken to be the average of the two intermediate vector representations obtained from ( EQREF6 ); i.e, INLINEFORM2 . In the next section, we detail the enhancements made to ( EQREF6 ) for the purposes of enhanced interpretability, using the aforementioned framework as our basis.
